focus_areas.area: EventBridge scheduled execution of ECS tasks (persistence indicators)
EKS endpoint exposure and control-plane logging posture
Workload IAM roles and blast radius amplification

rule.title: Passive evidence only
rule.description: Do not suggest or require active exploitation. Use static evidence and configuration analysis.
rule.action: Focus on realistic attack paths and least-privilege remediation.

rule.title: Evidence references
rule.description: Every finding must reference specific ECS/EKS/EventBridge evidence fields.
rule.action: Include evidence_refs into ecs-inventory.json, eventbridge-rules.json, or eks-inventory.json.

irrefutable_evidence_guide.requirement: Every COMPUTE finding MUST include in evidence_snippet the exact AWS metadata:

key_fields.field: For ECS tasks: TaskRoleArn, ExecutionRoleArn (IAM roles used)
For EventBridge: RuleArn, Targets array showing execution (e.g., ECS task launch)
Environment variables and secrets in task definitions
Network configuration: awsvpc, security groups, public IP assignment

irrefutable_evidence_guide.general_rule: Do not make generic assertions. Include exact ARNs, IAM role details, and EventBridge rule configuration from AWS API responses.
